mending_prose: Nothing here changes anything until you say yes to it.
mending_offer_prose: Nothing has changed yet. Choose what to put right, and lemonfiber makes sure this is still what it would do before it does any of it.
mending_reversible: It can be put back afterwards.
mending_irreversible: It cannot be put back afterwards.
backups_prose: Each backup is kept on this machine under the name it was written with. Nothing is put back until you have read what it holds and said yes.
backups_none: No backups are kept on this machine yet.
backups_listing_prose: Nothing has changed yet. What it holds is listed below. Putting it back replaces the settings it holds, and lemonfiber does it only while the stack is stopped.
backups_repoint: It was taken where lemonfiber kept its data at {was}. This machine keeps it at {now}.
support_prose: A support bundle gathers what somebody helping with this machine would need into one file, with passwords and keys replaced. You can read all of it before it is written.
support_bundle_prose: Nothing has been written yet. Every file it would hold is below, as it would be written.
quality_prose: The quality lemonfiber fetches new media at, for everything and for each kind of media set apart.
quality_transcodes_here: This machine would have to transcode it in software to play it.
quality_customised: The quality config has been edited by hand, so the recorded preset no longer decides what is fetched.
quality_cost_prose: Nothing has been fetched yet. What each kind of media would be fetched at is listed below.
config_origin_overridden: Set by the plugin {named}, over another value
config_origin_orphaned: Set by the plugin {named}, which is no longer installed
config_origin_unknown: Where this came from could not be read: {why}
config_origin_other: Set in a way this page has no words for
config_prose: Every setting lemonfiber keeps, and where each value came from. A change that costs nothing is made at once; one that costs something is shown to you first.
config_review_prose: Nothing has changed yet. What the change does is listed below, and saying yes makes it.
line_limited: Limits are in force, with no schedule switching them.
line_scheduled_active: It is the household's hours, so the limits apply.
line_scheduled_quiet: It is outside the household's hours, so the line is the stack's.
line_overridden: The limits are lifted for a while.
line_cap_warning: The month is close to the cap.
line_cap_exceeded: The cap has been reached, and what was declared for it applies.
line_unrecognised: Where the line stands is not something this page has words for.
line_verdict_unrecognised: something this page has no word for
line_share_hint: A share of the line, such as 50%, or a figure, such as 20Mbit. Left empty, it stays as it is.
line_active_hint: From when to when on the wall clock, such as 07:00-23:00.
line_line_hint: As download/upload, such as 100Mbit/20Mbit, where you know it.
line_cap_hint: How much the stack may move in a month, such as 500 gigabytes.
line_minutes_unread: A whole number of minutes above nothing.
updates_prose: See what moving the stack onto the versions this build pins would change. Nothing moves until you say yes under what was read.
update_plan_prose: Nothing has moved yet. Each step is listed below, and saying yes takes them.
line_cap_standing: The monthly cap is {cap}, and this month is {standing}.
line_metered: In {month} the stack moved {down} down and {up} up.
line_reached_unrecognised: somewhere this page has no word for
outbound_prose: Every request that leaves this machine: lemonfiber's own, each with what travels and the setting that switches it off, and those the stack's services make.
outbound_ours_nowhere: Nothing is set up for it to reach.
outbound_allowed: It is allowed. The setting {setting} switches it off.
outbound_off: It is switched off by the setting {setting}.
outbound_theirs_nowhere: It reaches nothing outside this machine.
outbound_whose_stack: The stack asks for this itself.
outbound_whose_unknown: Whose request this is could not be told: {why}
outbound_whose_other: This page has no word for whose request this is.
outbound_unrecorded: lemonfiber ships no record of what this service reaches, so what is said here is not checked against one.
outbound_none: Nothing here makes a request of its own.
alerts_prose: What you are told about: one preset for every kind of event, and the kinds you set apart from it.
alerts_none: No kind of event is set apart from the preset.
alerts_wanted: {kind}: you are told, whatever the preset says.
alerts_unwanted: {kind}: you are not told, whatever the preset says.
wiring_prose: What each service in the stack is wired to, and how each link was settled.
wiring_none: Nothing in the stack is wired to anything.
wiring_outright: It reaches {services}, the one service that does it.
wiring_each: It reaches every service that does it: {services}.
wiring_contested: {claimants} all do it, and nobody has chosen between them, so it reaches none of them.
wiring_chosen_by_you: It reaches {services}, which you chose over {over}.
wiring_chosen_by_stack: It reaches {services}, which the stack chose over {over}.
wiring_unfilled: Nothing does it, so it reaches nothing.
wiring_settled_other: How it was settled is something this page has no word for.
wiring_by_name: It is kept to {service} by name: {why}
wiring_nothing_fills: {by} asks for {capability}, and nothing does it.
glossary_prose: Every word lemonfiber explains, in the order you meet them: what each is for, and what it costs or gains.
glossary_also: Other services in this stack call it {words}.
survey_prose: What is already on this machine that is not lemonfiber's, and what taking it over or running beside it would come to. The ways forward are listed least disruptive first.
survey_unread: The container engine did not answer, so nothing on this machine could be looked at. This is not the same as finding nothing.
survey_none: Nothing else runs on this machine.
survey_adoptable: lemonfiber knows it, and could take it over as it stands.
survey_not_adoptable: lemonfiber could not take it over as it stands.
survey_conflict: {held} already holds port {port}, which {wanted} would publish.
survey_beside: To run beside it, {service} would listen on {to} instead of {from}.
survey_versions: {service}: {existing} is here, and lemonfiber pins {ours}. The later of the two: {verdict}.
survey_backup_first: Its database is backed up before lemonfiber opens it.
survey_refused: lemonfiber will not take this one over.
survey_filesystems: The existing setup keeps its data on {filesystems}.
survey_layout_kept: lemonfiber leaves the layout as it is: it and the library in it are yours.
survey_disturbs: It stops or changes what is running now.
survey_leaves_alone: It leaves what is running alone.
survey_preselected: It is the one offered already chosen.
plugin_prose: Every plugin on this machine: what it does, where it came from, what it runs and what it fills.
plugin_places_nothing: It runs no service of its own.
plugin_fills_nothing: It fills nothing the stack asks for.
plugin_source_reachable: {from} still answers, so it can be updated from there.
plugin_source_unreachable: {from} does not answer, so it cannot be updated from there. It keeps running as it was installed. {why}
plugin_source_unasked: Nobody asked whether its source still answers: {why}
plugin_source_other: Whether {from} still answers is something this page has no word for.
plugin_substituted: {service}, from the plugin {plugin}, fills {capability} in place of the stack's own, because you chose it.
credential_prose: Every credential the stack holds, where its value lives and everything that signs in with it. No value is shown here.
credential_stale: Not proved lately, so it may no longer work.
credential_invalid: Refused by what it signs in to.
credential_superseded: Replaced, and kept until everything has moved off it.
credential_state_other: Where it stands is something this page has no word for.
credential_by_service: The service it belongs to made it.
credential_by_other: Who made it is something this page has no word for.
credential_of_plugin: The plugin {named} brought the service it belongs to.
credential_of_unknown: Whose it is could not be told: {why}
credential_of_other: This page has no word for whose it is.
credential_setting: It is recorded under the setting {setting}.
credential_fingerprint: Its likeness, for telling two copies apart: {fingerprint}
copy_prose: The versions this machine runs, and whether a newer lemonfiber is released. Moving this copy is done by the tool that installed it.
copy_engine_unasked: The container engine could not be asked for its version.
copy_available: {offered} is released, and this copy is {version}.
copy_managed: {owner} keeps this copy, {version}, up to date.
copy_untold: Whether a newer release than {version} is out could not be told: {why}
copy_standing_other: Where {version} stands is something this page has no word for.
copy_installed_distribution: It was installed from this system's own packages.
copy_installed_installer: It was installed with lemonfiber's installer.
copy_installed_image: It runs from a container image.
copy_installed_elsewhere: It was put on this machine by hand.
copy_installed_untellable: How it was installed could not be told.
copy_installed_other: How it was installed is something this page has no word for.
catalogue_prose: Every service the stack holds, whether or not it runs: what it is for, what going without it costs, and where it comes from.
catalogue_core: It is part of what the stack is for.
catalogue_enhancing: It makes the rest better, and the rest works without it.
catalogue_optional: It is there for whoever wants it.
catalogue_criticality_other: How much it matters is something this page has no word for.
catalogue_origin_unread: Where it comes from could not be read.
catalogue_replaced: {id} was dropped in {version}, and {by} took its place: {reason}
stage_monitored: asked for, and waiting to be searched for
stage_unrecognised: a stage this page has no word for
trace_unmatched: Nothing lemonfiber watches for matches {item}, so nobody has asked for it.
trace_uncertain: The services name it differently, so this may not be the item you meant.
trace_coverage: {have} of the {wanted} parts asked for are here.
trace_grabbed: Handed to the download client at {at}.
trace_other: Something this page has no words for happened at {at}.
walk_offered: Nothing was named, so lemonfiber offered things likely to work and fetched nothing.
walk_complete: The walk finished, and it is ready to watch.
walk_failed: The walk stopped before the end.
walk_abandoned: The walk was left before the end.
walk_unrecognised: Where the walk ended is not something this page has words for.
walk_already_here: It was already here, so it was not fetched again.
walk_next_more: Next, add more, now the shape of it is clear.
walk_next_household: Next, let the household ask for things themselves.
walk_next_apps: Next, watch it on another device.
walk_next_other: Next, something this page has no words for.
guard_not_stopped: The guard could not stop these: {names}
walk_prose: Walk one thing through, from searching for it to having it ready to watch, and see each step it took. Name nothing, and lemonfiber picks something likely to work.
walk_item_hint: Leave it empty for something likely to work.
trace_prose: Name something to see how far it got, why it stopped, and what happened to it.
trace_season_hint: Leave it empty for every season.
trace_unread: Name something, and a season as a whole number or nothing.
walk_hardlinked: The library and the download share one file, so it takes its space once.
walk_copied: The file was copied into the library, so it takes its space twice until the download is let go.
hosting_prose: What this machine keeps running when no terminal is open. Each one is handed to the machine's service manager and runs until you stop keeping it.
hosting_service_file: The service manager reads it from {at}.
hosting_output: What it would have said on a terminal goes to {at}.
hosting_missing: The program its definition names is gone: {program}.
hosting_choose_forms: Choose the forms it guards in the forms panel first.
hosting_orphaned: installed, and the program it names is gone
hosting_unsupported: not something this machine's service manager can keep
hosting_unrecognised: somewhere this page has no word for
hosting_installed: {name} was handed to this machine to keep running.
hosting_removed: {name} was taken back off this machine.
removal_prose: Forget what lemonfiber keeps, or take it off this machine at one of four removals. Each is listed first with nothing removed, and nothing goes until you say yes under the listing.
forget_plan_prose: Nothing has been removed. Saying yes removes what the record below lists as kept, and leaves what it lists beside it.
remove_plan_prose: Nothing has been removed. Saying yes removes what the record below lists as going, and only that: if what it reaches changed since, lemonfiber refuses rather than remove something you did not read.
remove_confirmed: Agreed to as a rehearsal, so nothing was removed.
remove_left: {name} is still there ({why}). To remove it by hand: {by_hand}
remove_other: What became of the removal is not something this page has words for.
remove_item_secret: {name} holds a credential, and removing it destroys it.
remove_coming: Still coming down, and interrupted by this: {name}, {progress}%
remove_foreign: Not put there by the stack, so left alone: {at}, {files} files, {size}
remove_outside: {what} is not lemonfiber's to remove ({why}). To remove it by hand: {by_hand}
remove_outside_unfound: {what} was not found here, and is not lemonfiber's to remove ({why}). If it is there, remove it by hand: {by_hand}
remove_incomplete: Not everything this removal needed could be read, so the listing may be short:
forget_other: What forgetting did is not something this page has words for.
remove_media_prose: This removal deletes your media. Everything it takes comes to {size}.
candidate_seeding: still being shared, having sent {ratio} times what it received
candidate_unrecognised: somewhere this page has no word for
letting_offered: What letting {name} go would cost, with nothing let go yet:
letting_gone: The download client let {name} go, which gives back {size}.
letting_prose: Every completed download the disk accounting names, what it takes up and where it stands. What letting one that is still being shared go would cost is said first, and nothing goes until you say yes under it.
letting_none: No completed download is on the disk.
let_go_plan_prose: Nothing has been let go. Saying yes asks the download client to let go of what the record below names, and only that: if it changed since, lemonfiber refuses.
reclaim_prose: Every part of the disk that could be got back, what it takes up, and what getting it back would cost. lemonfiber offers only what costs nothing, and takes nothing until you say yes under it.
reclaim_none: Nothing on the disk could be got back.
reclaim_free_none: Nothing could be got back without a cost.
reclaim_offer: Saying yes deletes what the lines at no cost name, and only that: if the disk changed since it was read, lemonfiber refuses.
reclaim_unrecognised: Something this page has no word for
reclaim_cost_losing: only by losing what you chose to keep
reclaim_cost_landing: not yet, as it is being written now
reclaim_cost_tracker: at the cost of standing with its tracker
reclaim_cost_untaken: at no cost, as nothing ever took these
reclaim_cost_unpacked: at no cost, as the unpacked copy is the one in use
reclaim_cost_little: a little, and rarely worth it
reclaim_cost_refused: not at all, as you asked
reclaim_cost_unrecognised: at a cost this page has no word for
